name: Santa Fe
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Santa Fe for 2026, and here is what he found: 9 family events, 6 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (Annual Holiday Plaza Lighting on the Santa Fe Plaza) through December 31 (La Luz de las Noches at Santa Fe Botanical Garden), with Pablo's Holiday Express at Sky Railway (December 5 to 24), Las Posadas on the Plaza (December 13) and the Canyon Road Farolito Walk (December 24) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Santa Fe

  • 9 Christmas events for kids in Santa Fe
  • 6 free events, including the Plaza lighting, Las Posadas and the Canyon Road Farolito Walk
  • Meet Santa: Mr. and Mrs. Claus at the Plaza lighting (November 27) and Mrs. Claus on Pablo's Holiday Express
  • Parades and tree lightings: Annual Holiday Plaza Lighting and Las Posadas procession
  • Trains: Pablo's Holiday Express from the Lamy Depot, December 5 to 24
  • Season: November 27 to December 31
